contact_repair.vertex_identity: Known same-geom collision vertices bind only to a unique reference P1/P2 boundary node within the declared 1e-8 m correspondence bound; runtime witness equality is checked at floating-point roundoff.
contact_repair.profile: Certified intrinsic port paths with verified covered planar segments; positive area Gaussian/taper profile; no orientation mask.
contact_repair.local_integration: Q10 on the witnessed face's three anchor/edge triangles; other faces keep Q10. Original radius, application point, force, free moment and friction are unchanged.
contact_repair.feasibility: Original sampled cones are infeasible under a circumscribed 128-sided LP; a looser internal 5e-9 threshold and 1024 evaluations do not fix them. The finite anchor partition gives constructive inner-cone LP witnesses and native convergence in 20/19 evaluations.
contact_repair.lp_boundary_resolution: The repaired LP additionally includes the exact target force ray wherever it lies in the true local cone; this avoids classifying near-sliding force as infeasible solely because of angular polygon resolution.
contact_repair.acceptance: Wrench 1e-8; complete residual including all six gauge rows max(1e-11 N,1e-8 ||rhs||); stress rtol=1e-4,atol=1e-3 Pa.
